# text.line

Ensure a line is present or absent in a file (lineinfile-equivalent)

## Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
|----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `backup` | boolean | No | - |
| `insert_after` | string | No | - |
| `insert_before` | string | No | - |
| `line` | string | No | - |
| `path` | string | **Yes** | - |
| `regexp` | string | No | - |
| `state` | string | No | - |

## Platform Support

linux, darwin, windows, freebsd
